notes: Built from the 1.0.96 base and compiled for the Staff Java runtime so existing functionality stays intact.
Keeps the 1.0.101 check-in timestamp and Reports Dashboard fixes intact while adding the 1.0.102 workflow updates.
Adds a separate Services Declined action in Youth Log so staff can remove unneeded requested services without marking them received.
Fixes intake packet field placement for Client Track demographics, Basic Needs signatures, registration details, and Release & License signature lines.
Auto-fills youth signature/name lines in generated intake packets from the youth's full name.
Fixes future check-in times by storing check-in and checkout timestamps from the Vita Nova Eastern time shown to staff instead of the database server timestamp.
Fixes the Reports Dashboard load error caused by a decompiled table-check helper while preserving the existing report updates.
Fixes event staffing so Outside Volunteer and Intern remain assigned, display in the event table, and count as event staff.
Adds auto-dash formatting to Intake and SOFI packet date fields inside the staff dashboard packet editor.
Improves FAU roster printing so the roster uses a page-width print layout.
Restores keyboard text-size controls for larger, smaller, and reset text.
Updates visible wording from Nickname to Preferred Name and from Banned to Restricted where staff see it.
Adds The Spot restricted profile marking separately from Sleep Spot restriction.
Adds intake packet date auto-dashing, event staff options, and additional Vita Nova housing locations.
Records new check-in timestamps in the Vita Nova Eastern time zone.
